style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: every beat the ant scuttles sideways under his own power, never lying still, never pushed; hit, loaded or bitten, he skids and keeps scrabbling sideways; he glances at the lens only on the run; camera keeps pace at his eye level, nonstop; shot size shifts with the bodies, up to a face filling the frame; the ant never leaves frame
character: the ant: glossy black ant, tired eyes, twitchy antennae; the fat bronze dung beetle boss; worker ants; ONE mosquito
props: ONE gold coin stack; ONE banknote ball; ONE bread loaf; ONE crumb; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit sandy anthill yard, grass blades, pebbles; a line of worker ants hauling coins; the beetle boss by a bread loaf

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, weary but brisk, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ya ta-SHU na se-BYE BOL'-she, chem VYE-shu SAM. a v i-TO-ge hva-TA-yet TOL'-ko na od-NU KROSH-ku
audio.pacing: 0.6-6.2 one unbroken flow; after 6.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: coin clinks, sand scrapes, swooshes, buzz, crunch

timeline.a: the ant already scuttles sideways under ONE gold coin stack as two worker ants running beside him toss on a coin; he dips, skids and scuttles on
he carries the stack sideways left to right, six legs scrabbling, jaws flapping
he hauls the stack back right to left in a zigzag scuttle, legs buckling, nose ploughing the sand, jaws flapping, as ONE worker ant adds a coin
he scuttles sideways with the stack, jaws flapping, as the beetle boss rolls his ball alongside and scoops it off; suddenly light, he shoots off sideways, legs whirring
he scuttles sideways after the ball and his stack, belly low, legs scrabbling, jaws flapping
he scuttles sideways toward the loaf as the boss's huge snout sweeps past the lens beside him, snapping ONE crumb off it and flicking it into his face; he skids, heaving it onto his back
he scrambles sideways with the crumb on his back, legs buckling under it, glancing flat at the lens on the run, antennae drooping

he scuttles sideways with the crumb as ONE angry mosquito darts sideways across the lens, proboscis bared, wings bristling, huge beside him, and bites the crumb; he digs in, hauling it back in a tug-of-war
he tumbles sideways as the crumb snaps in half, rolling over twice, sand bursting at the lens; the mosquito zips off with its half
he flips onto his legs mid-slide and scuttles sideways, gulping his half whole on the run, his bulging cheeks sweeping past the lens filling the frame
he keeps scuttling sideways right to left as ONE gold coin flicked by the boss clinks onto his back; he buckles, skids and scrabbles on

must_appear: stack on his back while running 0.0; beetle scoops it 3.2; crumb in his face 6.2; mosquito bites crumb 7.4; coin on his back 9.3; huge faces: beetle 6.2, mosquito 7.4, ant 8.6
negative_prompt: held mic, a second mosquito, slow motion, any word after 6.2, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, price tags, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, mouth shut, duplicate props, floating objects, a hero running at the camera, a wide shot, a distant hero, a parked camera, static scenery, a motionless first or last second, top-down view, a cart, a rail, sky, sun in frame, low angle, standing on hind legs, on the spot, a hero lying still, a hero being dragged
